text: The pilot flying called "Flaps 15" at 10.9 s. The pilot monitoring selected flaps 15 at 11.9 s, and the flap gauge read 5 and then 15 at 29.3 s. Crosscheck stayed silent, which was right because the call matched the selection and the flaps needed about 13 s to travel.
